macros.name: AtWriteToIndex
macros.doc: The \AtWriteToIndex macro lets you execute a piece of code each time an index is written to a specific index.

macros.name: indexshortcut
macros.doc: The macro \indexshortcut is only defined within the body of \printindex and \printsubindex. It expands to the shortcut of the specific index that is being printed.

macros.name: printsubindex
macros.doc: Works like \printindex but changes some macros before to level down the headings at the index generation.
